Historical plant geometry capture, 2026-11-24

The twelve names in historical-plants-names.txt were registered directly
at f11cfac285997b5fbad53e16509b4bff22a87e3f, the parent of the commit
that retired the plant kind names. The capture uses that revision's factory
and the same geometry and material fingerprint as geometry_sample.go.
It does not add those names back to the public registry.

The producer historical_plant_sample.go accepts a names file, selects each
kind directly, and records seeds 5 and 11 at hull, clumps, quick and demo.
It ran on Darwin arm64 with go1.27.3, GOWORK=off and GOMAXPROCS=2.
Before the capture it reproduced all eight unchanged Valley Oak records.
The later f8ddbbbb checked-profile constructors reproduced all 96 captured
rows byte for byte. The explicit twig rounding fix was checked against all
96 rows on the current RC; all matched.

SHA-256:

  f11 plant-choices.yaml        1e069705eb7ce04b616d3e6bf7a1bebbd760991c57aa269099dd64e646f26b60
  historical_plant_sample.go   8d5da56718f135d5458db3231ff24e804b67e0348acc4f13642855da0c725a1c
  historical-plants-names.txt  ac2e6757bf0accfd0e3b1531a179119a2e95f5bbe0813cbe6c887d1b09f480e3
  historical plant records     ebbc00a17ec5b4cca4457314aebde0bd49efe8cc96310c7287136493ab71086f

Producer consolidation, 2026-11-24

The original plant producer's exact source is retained as the patch
history/historical-plant-producer.patch against the reconstructed original selected
public producer (SHA-256 3551acf3fca97e5c118f0c3b76db5342bd4d2a56386471ada6185d2287328094).
To reconstruct the original source without repository history:

    cp manufacture/testdata/geometry_sample_selected.go /tmp/historical_plant_sample.go
    patch -s /tmp/historical_plant_sample.go < manufacture/testdata/history/historical-selected-producer.patch
    patch -s /tmp/historical_plant_sample.go < manufacture/testdata/history/historical-plant-producer.patch

The zero-context patch has SHA-256
a2e69ccde5b64295425afb2c3c5865cb49647ddab246938303f6929953895e99.
The reconstructed source has the original SHA-256 recorded above. The
original selected public producer was also compiled against f11cfac2 and
run once per directly registered plant name; all 96 rows matched this
capture byte for byte. Its additive Sphere and Tube tags do not change the
plant meshes' fingerprint bytes.

The original selected producer is reconstructed as documented in
historical-selected-producer-provenance.txt.
